entries.name: Tavus
entries.description: Tavus — real-time video conversations with an AI replica (digital human) that can see, hear, and respond like a person, driven by a persona.

usage.callShape: GET https://x402.orth.sh/tavus/v2/conversations (as registered) — returns 404, route does not exist
usage.outputShape: body.error, body.message (404 error: "No matching endpoint found for GET /v2/conversations")
quirks: GET https://x402.orth.sh/tavus/v2/conversations returns HTTP 404 'No matching endpoint found for GET /v2/conversations' — no 402, no payment taken, no money lost.

The registry probe that classified this payable used POST (status 402), not GET. Tavus creates conversations via POST /v2/conversations, so the working method is almost certainly POST — the GET registration is wrong.
Do NOT retry GET; the route is dead. A future fix should re-register this as POST and re-QA, since POST may also require a body (e.g. {persona_id} or {replica_id}).
usage.guide: As registered (GET https://x402.orth.sh/tavus/v2/conversations) this endpoint is broken: it returns HTTP 404 'No matching endpoint found for GET /v2/conversations' with no payment required. Do not call it as a GET. The Tavus conversations API creates a conversation via POST /v2/conversations (the registry's own probe got a 402 on POST), likely requiring a body such as a persona_id or replica_id, so the registered method/shape is incorrect and must be fixed before this can work.

entries.name: LivePortrait Studio
entries.description: LivePortrait — animate a portrait image into a talking/expressive avatar video.

usage.callShape: POST https://x402-live-portrait.vercel.app/api/generate-x402 with JSON body {source_image_url, driving_video_url} (both HTTPS URLs, required); optional string flags flag_relative/flag_do_crop/flag_pasteback ("true"|"false")
quirks: Synchronous despite being video gen: the paid POST blocks until the result is ready and returns the final videoUrl directly in the body — no job id, no polling.
Both source_image_url and driving_video_url are REQUIRED and must be publicly reachable HTTPS URLs (the service fetches them server-side).
The optional flag_* params are STRINGS "true"/"false", not booleans.
Output is hosted on Vercel blob storage (public.blob.vercel-storage.com); download/re-host promptly if you need persistence.
usage.guide: POST a JSON body with source_image_url (a portrait image) and driving_video_url (the motion to transfer), both as public HTTPS URLs, to https://x402-live-portrait.vercel.app/api/generate-x402. Pay the $0.05 x402 charge on Base. The call is synchronous — when it returns 200 the body already contains the finished result. Read body.videoUrl for the animated mp4 and body.thumbnailUrl for the preview image; both are directly downloadable.

entries.name: HyperCLI Speaking Video
entries.description: Generate a speaking-avatar / talking-head video — animate a portrait (image_url) to lip-sync supplied audio (audio_url) or a text prompt, on HyperCLI's universal GPU runtime. Async render with status/cancel polling. Pay-per-call x402 (USDC on Base).

usage.callShape: POST https://api.hypercli.com/api/x402/flow/speaking-video with JSON body {prompt, image_url?, audio_url?, width?, height?}
usage.outputShape: unknown — server returns HTTP 500 plain-text "Internal Server Error" after payment; no body schema observed
quirks: Charges x402 ($0.25 USDC on Base, payment settles) then returns HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error' (plain text, 21 bytes) — broken server-side render.
Returns NO job id / async handle on failure, so the documented status/cancel polling cannot be reached.
Tested twice (minimal {prompt} and {prompt,image_url}); both identical 500. Do not retry — money is lost on each call.
usage.guide: Do NOT call this endpoint — it is broken.
